Noelle: "Ehehe. People really can adapt to anything."
*Noelle smiles to herself, looking pleased. I wonder why? Is it because we were finally able to clear the air after so long?*
*I'm sure knowing why I never kept in contact with her was a huge relief. Not knowing can be one of the worst things in the world. I can vouch for this pearl of wisdom as a first-grade worrier myself.*
Noelle: "Anyway... About our trip..."
Atcchan: "Yeah?"
Noelle: "Well, um... You said on the phone... It was for research? For some kind of manga?"
Atcchan: "Ah, that's right. I mean, um..."
Atcchan: "It may sound kind of unbelievable, but... through a series of coincidences, somehow, I managed to get roped into a very odd project. You see, um..."
Atcchan: "There's this woman, Tsuzumi - the one who works at the antiques store you like. I think you know her?"
Noelle: "The one with the dark hair?"
Atcchan: "That's right."
Noelle: "Ooh. I never knew she was called Tsuzumi."
*Neither did I until a few days ago - which I worry is particularly ignorant, given she even went to my school.*
*Noelle can be forgiven this gap in her knowledge since she transferred into our school late, only a year before Tsuzumi graduated, but I'd been in the same classroom with her for six years. Surely I should have remembered her name?*
*I guess not.*
*Even though I've lived in this village almost my entire life, I still don't know what all the trees in the forest are called, or how to identify birds by the sounds of their song. Maybe I'm just an unobservant person.*
*It must be because I spend so much time mulling over my own anxious musings, rather than focusing on the world around me...*
Atcchan: "Well, apparently Tsuzumi is a manga artist, and got me to help her somehow."
Noelle: "I didn't know you could draw, Atcchan."
Atcchan: "I can't. It's more like... she decided to send me on this trip for research. To find interesting characters to put in her story."
Noelle: "Oh. I see. I suppose that makes sense."
*Noelle nods her head, her purple ribbon fluttering.*
Noelle: "And you want me to draw some of these characters? Is that why you asked me to come?"
Atcchan: "Well, partially... B-But I do want to spend some time with you, too."
Atcchan: "I thought going on a trip to the beach together... would be fun. E-Even if it is a business trip."
Noelle: "Ah... Well, um..."
*Noelle turns her head away, hiding underneath her bangs.*
Noelle: "T-Thank you. I-I won't let you down! I'll do my best!"
Atcchan: "You could never let me down, no matter what. I have complete and utter faith in you."
Noelle: "R-Really...?"
Atcchan: "Really. You are my best friend, after all."
*The two of us wait around for a few more minutes, engaged in light conversation.*
*Noelle looks about her, at the school dyed orange under the morning light, and frowns.*
Noelle: "Where are Amu and Paya? I thought they were meant to meet us here."
*Not that Noelle knows what Paya looks like, given she's never met her before.*
*Is that why Noelle looks so anxious, fidgeting alternately with the hem of her skirt and the ribbon in her hair?*
*She's never been very good at dealing with strangers, even though she has no problems poking fun at me.*
*Come to think of it, she's never gotten along that well with Amu, either.*
*I don't think it's that the two dislike one another, though - they just have very little in common, and so struggle to make conversation.*
*I hope this trip turns out all right after all...*
Atcchan: "I guess it's kind of early. Maybe they're running late?"
Noelle: "You think?"
*It's 6:00 a.m.*
*Since the beach is about three and half hours away by car, Tsuzumi stipulated that we should meet together as early as possible, so we could spend more time at the beach.*
*I can't fault her logic there, but... getting up at 6:00 a.m. during a holiday? Really? That's even earlier than I have to get up for school!*
*Isn't that a really cruel and unusual punishment? Even now, with the refreshing breeze blowing across my face, I can't stifle my yawns.*
*By contrast, Noelle looks fresh and sweet, like a newly picked flower. She doesn't have a single strand of hair out of place.*
*She peers at me from under her fringe, blinking slowly.*
Noelle: "I don't think it's that early."
Atcchan: "You would say that, being a morning person. Not everybody is the same."
*Paya's behavior yesterday doesn't fill me with much confidence. She was even able to fall asleep standing up.*
*I didn't know that was physically possible. I thought it was just a thing cartoon characters did.*
*Evidently not.*
*Are we really going to okay with that woman driving us? I kept having nightmares about it yesterday - visions of my imminent, fiery death. Maybe that's why I feel so tired now.*
*I don't want to die in a car crash. Not after I've managed to make up with Noelle. It seems like such a messy and unnecessary way to go...*
*As it turns out, however...*
*Even though Paya was more than twenty minutes late and she greeted us with a sleepy smile, she's actually more competent at driving than I thought.*
*Her car (I don't know what type of car it is - I've never been good with stuff like that) handles smoothly, able to make even the bumpy, pot-hole ridden roads that weave around our village seem like a length of long, unbroken, velvet ribbon.*
*I'm impressed.*
*I guess what they say is true. You really can't judge people based on appearances after all.*
*Amu, who arrived fashionably late herself (though not quite as late as Paya) is sitting in the front of the car, fiddling around with the radio.*
*Amu always fiddles with things - especially things that don't belong to her. She's like a monkey.*
Amu: "Do you have any tapes? Can't we put on some music?"
Paya: "Music distracts me."
Amu: "Distracts you?"
*Although I can only see the back of Amu's head, I imagine she's pulling a face.*
Amu: "But isn't that the point of music? To distract? Driving for so long without anything to occupy your mind must get really boring!"
Paya: "No. It isn't boring."
Amu: "You mean you like it?"
Paya: "Mm. It is... relaxing. The vibrations are soothing."
Amu: "W-Well, make sure it doesn't soothe you so much you fall to sleep..."
Paya: "Shuu...~"
*Paya yawns again, a light and airy sound with less substance than air. That yawn makes my back stiffen, preparing for the worst, but nothing comes of it.*
*Paya continues to handle the car just as well as before, rolling along at a pleasant speed - not too fast, not too slow.*
*Even I, who knows nothing about cars, can tell. She really is good at this.*
*She isn't like my mother, who grips the steering wheel so tight her knuckles turn white, hissing obscenities under her breath at anybody who dares to overtake her.*
*She isn't like my father, who's so cautious he always ends up driving far too slowly, to the irritation of everybody behind him.*
*Maybe Paya has a talent...*
Paya: "I wouldn't fall asleep when driving. It's fun...~"
Amu: "You think this is fun?"
Paya: "Mm. Like sewing, or knitting... it's the same kind of thing~"
Amu: "And you actually like doing that stuff?"
Paya: "The repetitive motions... there's a kind of beauty in it. It is... aesthetically pleasing..."
Amu: "Well, I guess we all have our hobbies. Even if they are kind of weird."
Paya: "Heehee~ Suzu calls me weird a lot... But I think that's hypocritical...~"
Amu: "Haha. Tsuzumi really is the weirdest, isn't she?"
Paya: "Indeed~"
*Noelle, sitting by my side in the back of the car, nods her head.*
Noelle: "I... I-I can relate to that, a little..."
*Amu turns about, her pink ponytail bouncing, and gives Noelle a confused glance.*
Amu: "You can?"
Noelle: "Y-Yes. I mean, um..."
*Her face flushing, Noelle ducks her head, clutching her sketchbook close to her chest. As per my instructions yesterday, she brought it along with her, to aid us in our character-creating attempts.*
Noelle: "I like drawing... because it is relaxing. Moving the pencil across the page... It's repetitive, but that is what makes it enjoyable."
Amu: "Haah? Maybe that's why I'm no good at it, then. I always get too impatient."
Noelle: "I-It takes a while, but... that is what makes it worthwhile, I think. Things that take a long time... are the most fulfilling."
*I offer Noelle a small smile.*
Atcchan: "Like when you used to walk forty minutes into town just to buy that jello you like so much?"
Noelle: "Yes. Exactly like that. The walk made the jello taste even better."
Amu: "Heh. I don't know what you're talking about. When I want something, I want it right away! Waiting around is way too boring."
Atcchan: "And that's why you've never gotten good grades in school."
Amu: "Heheh. Says you. You never got grades any better than me, mister!"
Atcchan: "I... Au..."
*I break off, looking at my lap.*
*Even though I want to, I can't refute Amu's words. She's right.*
*I've never really stood out at any subjects in school - not math, not science, not art. I'm passably decent when it comes to Japanese literature, but I'm woefully average when it comes to everything else.*
*Even though I actually try to study, unlike Amu, who shrugs off all these responsibilities with an 'It's not interesting so I don't care!', I never scored that much higher than her...*
*And the sad thing is, I get the strong feeling, if Amu actually put a little bit of effort into her academic career, she'd get really good grades. She just doesn't want to.*
*Why am I so useless? Was I born with cotton wool instead of a brain?*
Noelle: "Hey... Cheer up."
Atcchan: "Waaah... Noelle..."
*I look at Noelle, seeking comfort in her soft smile, the nostalgic way her silver hair falls over her shoulders.*
*Is she going to comfort me during my time of need?*
*This must be because Noelle is a true friend. Unlike Amu, she doesn't make fun of me...!*
Noelle: "Sometimes, no matter how hard you try... you can never succeed. Some people are just bad at things - so why don't you give up?"
Atcchan: "Aaah...!"
*That wasn't comforting at all! If anything, it felt like an insult!*
Amu: "Kukuku~ Noelle, I had no idea you were so mean!"
Noelle: "It was mean?"
Amu: "Incredibly! You broke his poor heart in two!"
Noelle: "Oh... Oh dear. I was only trying to be truthful..."
Amu: "But there are some times where the truth is just too painful! Couldn't you have spared his feelings with a little white lie?"
Noelle: "Oh, yes! How impressive that you thought of such a thing! It never even crossed my mind..."
*Noelle bows her head to Amu in thanks, not a single trace of irony on her face.*
Noelle: "Amu, you are very clever. That is a very high level technique..."
Amu: "Ehehe, well...~"
*Amu grins sheepishly, mussing up her hair with one hand.*
Amu: "It's not so clever. It just seems like common sense."
Noelle: "I see..."
*Noelle clenches her hand into a fist at her front.*
Noelle: "'Common sense'... My mother always tells me I don't have enough of it. I need to study hard so I can improve myself."
Paya: "I'll join in too~ Suzu says I have no common sense either... Shuu..."
Noelle: "So, following what I have learned... I will try to amend my previous statement."
*Noelle turns to me, brushing her hair out of her eyes, and smiles.*
Noelle: "You are not completely stupid, Atcchan, even though you do not have any particular talents. I am sure, if you work hard, someday you will be able to achieve something. Don't give up!"
Atcchan: "Waah!"
*I whimper in pain, clutching my hand to my chest. It feels as though I've been shot by an arrow. An arrow tipped with a lethal poison.*
*Although Noelle told me earlier people can become immune to poison if they take small doses every day... for me, it's already far too late. I can feel my immune system shutting down, my last vestiges of self-respect draining away.*
*Is this a form of punishment? Is Noelle trying to make me feel bad for abandoning her? Or else... was that a genuine attempt to comfort me?*
Atcchan: "N-Noelle... Y-You don't... You don't really think I'm stupid, do you?!"
Noelle: "Um..."
*...*
*...*
*Why is this pause so long? This should be a simple yes or no answer, shouldn't it?!*
Noelle: "Under normal circumstances I would say 'Yes, a little.', but... Apparently, telling white lies can spare the feelings of others, and strengthen relationships. And so, with this thought in mind..."
*A sparkling, seraphic smile.*
Noelle: "No! I don't think you're stupid at all!"
Atcchan: "Aaah, so cruel!"
*I moan in defeat, slumping back against my seat with a thud. All I want to do is curl up into a ball, right out of existence...*
*Sob, sob...*
Amu: "Whew..."
*Amu whistles under her breath. She looks impressed.*
Amu: "You really knocked Atcchan down there, Noelle. I don't think he'll be getting up again for a while."
Noelle: "You... You mean I did something wrong? Was my technique too powerful...?"
Amu: "It... It really was powerful."
Amu: "Maybe you shouldn't try to be polite to people anymore."
Amu: "Yay! We're finally here! It's the beach, the beach!"
*Amu clambers out of the car before Paya's even had the time to turn off the engine, moving in a flurry of flailing limbs and fluttering hair.*
*She slams the car door hard, far harder than necessary. The resultant thud splits through the air, making me jump.*
Amu: "Come on, everybody, aren't you excited?! We're at the beach! Let's go, let's go!"
Atcchan: "You sure sound energetic for somebody who fell asleep on the way here..."
Amu: "Of course I fell asleep, I had to wake up at 6:00 a.m.! What were you expecting, duh?"
*Was that 'duh' really necessary?*
*Well, at least she seems enthusiastic.*
Noelle: "Wow... How impressive."
*Noelle nods her head with what appears to be newfound respect, her eyes wide.*
Noelle: "I couldn't be like that. I would just tire myself out..."
Atcchan: "Most people would get tired if they lived like Amu. Maybe that's why she needed a nap. To power up her batteries."
Noelle: "Amu runs on batteries?! You mean she's a robot?!"
Atcchan: "Ah, no... Not really. It was a figure of speech."
Noelle: "Oh. I see..."
*Noelle sighs.*
*She isn't upset by this revelation, is she? Did she want Amu to be a robot?*
*What a strange girl.*
Amu: "Hey, guys! Come on, come on! You're wasting valuable beach time! Let's get going!"
Atcchan: "Haha... She's pretty insistent, isn't she?"
Noelle: "Mm. A little. But..."
Atcchan: "But?"
*Noelle frowns, retrieving her sketchbook from her lap and hugging it to her chest.*
Noelle: "I think... it's admirable, in a way. To live life like that, always smiling. I wish I could do it too."
Atcchan: "Noelle..."
*I wonder...*
*Even though these two haven't really spoken before, could this trip change all that?*
*Maybe, just maybe... going out together like this, forced to spend time in one another's company, could help their relationship grow stronger.*
*I'd like that. If Noelle and Amu, two of my best friends, could set aside their differences and become closer, even if it is just a little... it would make me happy.*
*I think they could both use a good friend.*
*I shift, unbuckling my seatbelt and opening the car door.*
*When I step outside, I'm greeted by the smell of salt. It dances in the air, lingering on my tongue.*
*I can't hear the cicadas here. Instead, I'm greeted by the noisy caw of the seagulls.*
*This really is the seaside, huh? I haven't been here in ages. The last time I went to the beach was probably four or five years ago.*
*Time sure does fly.*
*Noelle steps out of the car alongside me, still holding her sketchbook. The sea breeze, cool and crisp, makes her white dress flutter around her knees; toying with the purple ribbon in her hair so it dances like a paper streamer.*
*Amu bounds forwards to meet me, taking hold of my hands in hers.*
Amu: "Yay! Finally, you're here! I've been waiting soooo long!"
*I flush when our hands make contact and look away, directing my gaze a little over her shoulder.*
Atcchan: "There's no need to be melodramatic. It's only been a couple of minutes..."
Amu: "Only? Only? A couple of minutes is a long time, Atcchan! It can mark the difference between peace and war, life and death!"
Atcchan: "That may be true, but none of us are in imminent danger of dying, are we?"
Amu: "You never know. Don't get too complacent, Atcchan."
*I gulp.*
Atcchan: "Was that... a threat?"
Amu: "Who knows? Kukuku~"
*Amu turns about, letting go of my hands, and looks back towards the car.*
Amu: "Now, where's Paya?"
*Where indeed? That is a very good question.*
*I follow Amu's gaze, turning back to the car.*
*Sitting in the drivers seat, her head leaning against the steering wheel, her visible eye tightly shut, is Paya.*
*There's a string of drool glistening on her chin, and her chest is rising and falling slowly. It looks like she's asleep.*
*Did she fall asleep the very moment she pulled the car into the parking lot?*
*That... is kind of troubling. What if she'd done the same thing when we were out in the middle of the road?!*
*Maybe Amu was right. We could have been skirting a lot closer to death than any of us imagined...*
Paya: "Shuu..."
*Paya yawns, pressing one hand against her mouth. Her hair looks even more disheveled than usual, and tears are beading in the corners of her eyes.*
*Amu looks at her dubiously.*
Amu: "How are you even able to hold down a job?"
*For a few moments, Paya herself looks worried about this query.*
Paya: "It is a mystery..."
Amu: "It really is..."
Paya: "Heehee~"
Noelle: "So, um... A-About this project we're working on, um... What kind of manga is it, exactly?"
Amu: "Huh. That's a very good question, Noelle."
Noelle: "I-It is?"
Amu: "Yeah. Unfortunately..."
*Amu frowns, one hand under her chin.*
Amu: "Tsuzumi wasn't super generous with her information. I don't really know. She said it was a romance story, but I don't know what kind of romance."
Noelle: "Oh. But..."
*Noelle starts to fiddle with her sketchbook. She looks anxious.*
Noelle: "I-If we do not know what kind of story she is writing, h-how will we know what kind of characters to include?"
Amu: "Another good question."
Amu: "Although it's all kind of vague... Tsuzumi did specify that we should look for cute girls at the beach. So I guess most of the characters should be young girls."
Noelle: "Young girls... I see."
*Noelle nods her head, committing this piece of information to her mind with that single gesture.*
Noelle: "I... I am not very good at drawing people. I prefer drawing animals and landscapes. I... I-I just hope my skills will be sufficient..."
Amu: "Hey. I'm sure it'll be fine~"
*Noelle blinks. She looks surprised. Is that because of the unexpected vote of confidence, coming from a girl she hardly knows?*
Amu: "Yeah! I've seen the paintings you do in art class, and some of them are really good! Even if I don't understand the newest one you've been working on. Ehehe..."
Noelle: "W-Well, that painting... T-That's more of a work in progress. I-I might not finish it at all."
Amu: "Huh? But why not?! Miss Tachibana said it looked really good!"
Noelle: "I... I know that, but... I-It's kind of personal..."
Amu: "Personal?"
*Amu wrinkles her nose.*
Amu: "I don't know how something like that could be 'personal.' Isn't it just a load of spirals?"
Noelle: "I-I... Well... I-If it appears that way, it means... I probably haven't done my job. A-As an artist, that painting is a failure... Really, I should just scrap it and move on..."
Atcchan: "What picture are you talking about...?"
Noelle: "I-It's nothing, really. It's more like a scribble than anything else - and it's outdated now, anyway."
Atcchan: "Outdated...?"
*Can art really get 'outdated?' Even really, really old works of art still get displayed in galleries, and are often lauded as masterpieces.*
*It seems I have a lot to learn about art after all.*
Noelle: "W-Well, um... I drew the picture based on how I feel, but..."
*Noelle blinks up at me from over her sketchbook, her lashes fluttering.*
Noelle: "Obviously, as a human being... my feelings change a lot. They change all the time. So it was... hard... to capture how I felt."
Noelle: "I wanted to create something... objective, maybe. Something... T-That was 'true'... that could not be misinterpreted through language. But..."
Noelle: "I... I don't know if I feel like I did before anymore, so... the painting is worthless now."
Atcchan: "I... I see..."
*Even though I don't - not really. Maybe it would help if I actually knew what the painting in question looked like, but I doubt I'll get a chance to see it.*
*Amu doesn't really seem to get it either, though, and she does have the privilege of knowing what that painting looks like. Maybe it's something too abstract to understand.*
*I think trying to explain what 'art' is, especially 'good art', is quite difficult. It's something philosophers have pondered over for a long time, and they don't all agree with one another.*
*Trying to explain things using language is a lot harder than people give it credit for.*
Noelle: "A-Anyway, um..."
*Tentatively, Noelle tries to steer the subject matter away from her painting, towards safer ground.*
Noelle: "S-Should we start doing research for Tsuzumi's manga? I-I wouldn't want to let her down..."
Amu: "Huh? Oh. Nah."
*Amu's reply is flippant, completely casual. She grins, waving one hand in a dismissive motion.*
*Noelle frowns.*
Noelle: "But... Didn't we come here so we could do research?"
Amu: "Ostensibly yes, but..."
*I shudder, thinking back to those very long, very sharp fingernails Tsuzumi has. You could probably dissect a frog with talons like that, more effectively than any blunted scalpel in a biology classroom could.*
*Saki is forever bemoaning that the scalpels in our class aren't sharp enough, and she can't cut open her specimens with the precision they deserve.*
Atcchan: "Yeah. If we don't do what Tsuzumi wants we might get in serious trouble..."
Paya: "Suzu is a scary person. She has a very short temper..."
Amu: "Hey, I'm not saying we shouldn't do our work. That's not it at all."
Atcchan: "Then what are you saying, exactly?"
Amu: "I'm saying, since we came to the beach, we might as well have some fun! It'd be a waste coming all this way if we never got eat ice cream, or split a watermelon, or go swimming, or let off fireworks, right?!"
Atcchan: "But you had an ice cream yesterday."
Paya: "Watermelon is so expensive... I'd rather have meat..."
Noelle: "A-And I didn't bring a swimsuit, either..."
Amu: "Tsk, tsk."
*Amu clicks her tongue against the roof of her mouth and wags a finger in our direction, just like an admonishing teacher.*
Amu: "Why are you giving up so easily, you guys? I'm disappointed! There's an easy way to get around all these problems, you know?!"
Atcchan: "Which is...?"
*Amu grins, her face lighting up like a beacon.*
Amu: "Let's go shopping~! "
Noelle: "Ah... D-Do you... Do you really think this suits me?"
Amu: "Of course it does! It's adorable!"
Noelle: "I... I don't really know..."
Amu: "You don't trust me?"
Noelle: "N-No, it isn't that, it's just... Um..."
Amu: "Then let's get a second opinion! Hey, Atcchan!"
Atcchan: "What is it?"
*I lift my head, blinking in the direction of the girls' changing rooms.*
*Amu dragged Noelle in there a while ago, with this store's entire swimsuit section crammed underneath her arm.*
*I felt a pang of guilt as I watched Amu ferry Noelle away, wondering if I should do something to stop her.*
*The pleading look Noelle shot me over her shoulder, her eyes wide, face flushed, sure seemed like a cry for help, but...*
*When Amu gets fired up, she really gets fired up. She was charging forwards like a bulldozer, her eyes blazing with passion.*
*I knew, if I got in her way, she'd only run me over.*
*I'm sorry, Noelle. I'm sorry that my cowardice condemned you to such a grim fate...*
*We've been wondering around stores for a while now, on Amu's hunt for the perfect swimsuit.*
*For a girl who doesn't like clothes that much, and usually favors comfortable sweaters over cute dresses, Amu's being awfully thorough about this search.*
*I expected her to just pick up the cheapest swimsuit in the first store we went to, but she's actually taking it seriously.*
*Maybe it's because Noelle's with her. Is she just excited that she has somebody else to dress up?*
*When we were younger, Amu was always trying to force me into her clothes - especially when I lost those sadistic 'punishment games' of hers...*
*I shudder at the memory. They really were... embarrassing times.*
*In a way, I'm glad I go to a new school now. At least Saki, Miho, and Yuuna don't know about these humiliating memories from my childhood - and I intend to keep it that way.*
Amu: "Atcchan, we're going to show you how we look! Make sure you give your honest opinion, okay?!"
Atcchan: "Ah... Sure. I'll be honest."
Amu: "Good~ Now. On the count of three. One..."
Noelle: "D-Do we really have to?"
Amu: "Two..."
Noelle: "I-I'm not sure about this..."
Amu: "Three!"
Amu: "Tada~!"
*And with a triumphant yell, Amu throws open the door of the changing rooms, revealing herself in all her swimsuited glory.*
*Amu's outfit is a surprisingly cute choice: a two-piece costume in pink. She stands there proudly, one hand on her hip, grinning.*
*Noelle, meanwhile, is hiding behind Amu's back, so it's a little hard to see what she looks like, but... It seems like Amu has picked out a white and pale purple costume for her, with a lot of ruffles and frills.*
*Noelle's hair is even tied up in two pigtails. I've never seen her style her hair like that before.*
*Where did Amu get those hair accessories, anyway...? Did she pick them up off a shelf?*
*She really planned this attack through, didn't she? Maybe this girl could have been a great military general, if she lived several hundred years ago.*
Amu: "So? What do you think~?"
*Amu beams, turning about in a circle. Her braids bounce as she moves, jubilant.*
*I stare at her, unsure. She isn't going to hit me if I say the wrong thing, is she?*
Paya: "Ooh... It's cute..."
*At least Paya comes to my rescue; answering for me with her now-familiar sleepy smile.*
*Amu puffs out her chest proudly, hands on her hips.*
Amu: "Of course it's cute! I chose it, didn't I? Hohoh~!"
*No. It doesn't fit her. That princess-like laugh doesn't fit Amu's character at all...*
*Paya doesn't seem to mind this discrepancy between Amu's voice and her appearance, however. Instead, she smiles sleepily, nodding her head.*
Paya: "Well done. I'm impressed. Clap, clap, clap."
*She's even applauding? Does Amu really deserve that much praise?*
*However... Paya seems to forget, during her round of applause, that she was supposed to be holding Noelle's sketchbook.*
*The sketchbook falls from her hands, now otherwise disposed, and lands on the floor with a thud.*
Noelle: "M-My... My sketchbook..."
*Noelle peers out from over Amu's shoulder, eyes wide.*
*She's making the kind of expression a mother might make if their newborn baby was dropped, head-first, on the floor, by a particularly incompetent doctor.*
*I'm worried, judging by the light film over her eyes, that she might start crying.*
*Being dragged around by Amu for two hours, forced in and out of numerous swimsuits, must have been stressful. This clumsy mishandling of her sketchbook, her most prized possession, may be the final straw.*
*Paya, however, remains oblivious.*
Paya: "Ooh? What's wrong? Why should you look so sad when you're so cute?"
*Has she even realized she's dropped Noelle's sketchbook?*
*Does Paya even live in the same reality as the rest of us...?*
Atcchan: "H-Hey, don't worry. I've got it."
*I offer Noelle what I hope is a comforting smile and bend down, fishing the sketchbook up off the floor. Luckily, it hasn't gotten too dusty, and none of the pages seem to be bent.*
*Noelle returns my smile with a small, hesitant one of her own.*
Noelle: "T-Thank you, Atcchan."
Atcchan: "It's no problem. I'd take care of your sketchbook even if it cost me my life!"

*I shudder, thinking back to Tsuzumi's very long, very pointed fingernails.*
*She really is a frightening person - but I suppose that can have its uses.*
*I wish I could say something to that waitress; maybe tell her to stop looking at Paya, to stop laughing.*
*I'm sure Tsuzumi would be able to do that in a heartbeat. She doesn't seem to care what other people think about her at all.*
*But I... I'm not like that. I'm shy, easily anxious, and I...*
*I don't know what to say.*
*All I can do is sit here, my face flushing, hands curled into fists on my lap.*
*I feel angry, sure, but... since I'm too pathetic to act upon my feelings, it's a pointless anger. An anger that doesn't mean anything.*
Paya: "Hey. It's all right."
*Paya smiles consolingly. Could she tell what I was thinking?*
Paya: "You don't need to do anything. It isn't your fault. Just sitting here, with me, is enough already~"
Atcchan: "S-So you, um... Y-You don't mind...?"
Paya: "No~ You probably mind much more than I do. Because you're not used to it. But I am, so I don't care."
Paya: "I don't need anybody to defend me. I'm just fine on my own. Heehee~"
Atcchan: "W-Well... I-If you're sure..."
Paya: "Of course I am~ Nobody know me better than me~ Hmm, hmm~ "
*And, humming under her breath, Paya picks up her spoon once more; savoring another spoonful of ice cream.*
*The joyful look on her face, as she lets the ice cream melt across her tongue... is pretty endearing. I can't help but smile.*
*That she's able to remain so happy, even after that waitress was so rude to her... It's kind of inspiring.*
*Despite her soft outer appearance, Paya is a lot stronger than she looks.*
Paya: "Aaah~ I love this place so much~"
*The place Paya and I ended up at might seem slightly unconventional, but it was her choice. After I decided to go shopping, I asked Paya if there were any stores she particularly wanted to visit... and this is what she said.*
*She said she wanted to go to this small gardening store.*
*Whenever Amu dragged me out on shopping trips in the past, she nearly always took me to music stores, so she could flip through the latest albums or drool over the guitars that she didn't know how to play and didn't have enough money to buy.*
*With Miho and Yuuna, it's clothes shops. I've been clothes shopping with them after school more times than I can count - sometimes even accompanied by Saki, although she prefers strange, gothic stores with rails filled with clothes suitable for vampires rather than mainstream shops.*
*I've never seen a girl look so excited about the prospect of going to a gardening store, however.*
*These kinds of places are almost always populated entirely by old people - people who have enough free time to worry about their gardens, and the most auspicious ways to arrange flowers.*
*I didn't think they'd be popular with people under the age of thirty.*
*Does Paya even have her own garden? Her own house? I don't know. My knowledge about her is very limited, given I've only known her a few days.*
*Still... this place is rather relaxing - especially when compared to the gloomy confines of Tsuzumi's antiques shop.*
*The back of this gardening shop is like a large greenhouse in order to give the plants the necessary amount of sunshine.*
*The flowers are very colorful, pulsing with life, beads of dew glistening on their leaves, inside their petals. Bees, large and fluffy, buzz in the air, drifting by lazily in a manner that almost reminds me of Paya herself.*
*The air is infused with the smell of blooming flowers and damp earth, mixed with various herbs I can't place names to - basil, maybe, and thyme? I don't know.*
*I've never been too good at gardening - even though I have helped my mother with her garden a few times in the past. A few times were far too many, as it turned out, given I ended up over-watering her beloved gardenias...*
*Now, that's an incident she hasn't let me forget in a hurry. I bet she'll hold that against me even on her deathbed.*
*My mother is quite good at keeping petty grudges. She's not very much like my grandparents, who always seem so easygoing.*
Paya: "I could spend hours here... Hours and hours. It's so nice~"
Atcchan: "So... You didn't come here to buy anything?"
Paya: "Not really. I prefer to look~"
*So she says, even though her eyes are closed.*
*How can she see anything like that? And, even when her eyes are open, doesn't all that hair get in the way?*
*It doesn't seem very practical.*
Atcchan: "You come here a lot?"
Paya: "Quite a lot~ It's very soothing~"
Atcchan: "E-Ehehe, well... I have to agree with you there."
Paya: "Particularly after I've spent lots of time in Suzu's company. Sometimes, you need to unwind~ Even an easygoing person like me... can find her hard to deal with~"
Atcchan: "Really? Even you?"
Paya: "Of course. Every person has their limits~"
*I blink at Paya, surprised.*
*She always seems so relaxed I never even imagined she could get angry. Of course, that's a foolish thought - and slightly dehumanizing.*
*Every person is capable of feeling anger. Some people just don't show it as often as others.*
Atcchan: "Your limits must be very, um... very generous."
Paya: "Heehee~ I like to think so~ That's why I'm the only person on Suzu's original team that hasn't deserted her, I think~"
Paya: "That, and the fact I like her. Most of the time. I think she's funny~"
Atcchan: "Funny?"
Paya: "Mm. She makes me laugh. And there is nothing more precious in this world than laughter~"
Atcchan: "But she makes you mad, too?"
Paya: "Of course. A lot of the time. Because she's so rude... and so self-centered... and so self-defeating. And she never appreciates others... unless they're little sisters."
Paya: "She has... a lot of flaws. A critical amount. But I want to be her friend all the same. We've known each other since we were children, after all."
Paya: "Heehee~"
*And, giggling softly, Paya bends down, sniffing a display of bright purple flowers I think might be lavender.*
*I guess the time I spent in the garden with my mother wasn't a complete waste after all. At least I'm not wholly ignorant about flowers.*
Atcchan: "You... You really are a nice person, aren't you?"
Paya: "Hm?"
*Paya blinks. She turns her head to look at me, her braid falling over her left shoulder, her mouth open in a small 'o'.*
*She's still kneeling down by the display of lavender. A beam of sunlight filters through the glass ceiling and illuminates her hair, making it shine.*
*In this kind of pose, surrounded by all those flowers... she almost looks like a Mucha painting. Waifish and ethereal.*
Paya: "I don't think I am nice. I just think... Suzu is interesting. No matter how much she annoys me, I will put up with her... because she amuses me."
Paya: "And anyway... I need to keep up my Suzu observation diary."
Atcchan: "Y-You keep a diary?"
Paya: "Yes~ I keep lots and lots of diaries... for growing things. For all the flowers in my garden."
*So she does have a garden? I guess that makes sense, given how much she seems to like flowers.*
Paya: "I take note... of how much water I've given them each day... and if they've started to wither..."
Paya: "If the leaves have any holes in them... The colorization of the flowers... The angle they're facing at..."
Paya: "There are lots of small things to keep track of, really~ It's very relaxing~ "
Atcchan: "So you like gardening?"
Paya: "I like it a lot! Maybe because of Dad. He always says gardening is rewarding... creating order out of chaos, and making the world beautiful."
Paya: "But it can be a very fiddly business. So I keep a diary, so I can track the progress of my garden as best as possible~ Heehee~"
*Paya giggles softly.*
Paya: "And I have my Suzu observation diary, too~ Where I keep note of... the funny things she's done or said... What she's been eating... How many customers she's offended each day... "
Paya: "When the time comes, I'm going to publish it and earn millions~ "
Atcchan: "W-What do you mean, when the time comes?"
Paya: "Hmm... I'm not sure, exactly~"
*Paya pauses, blinking slowly.*
Paya: "When she finally snaps and does something crazy, like kidnapping a bunch of pretty girls and hiding them in her shop?"
Atcchan: "W-Waah...!"
*I jump in alarm.*
*All of a sudden, it feels like something cold and slippery has slid down the back of my shirt.*
Atcchan: "D-Do you really think Tsuzumi would do something like that?!"
Paya: "I don't know. It seems likely..."
*Paya smiles.*
Paya: "But, when the time comes... I'll be ready~"
Paya: "I've been ready to capitalize off any misdeed Suzu may do in her life... for years and years~"
Paya: "I'll publish my diary... And go on lots of talk shows... And tell the world about my friendship with the deranged, perverted serial kidnapper who kept going after little sisters."
Paya: "Maybe it'll even be made into a movie! And I can be the brave heroine who puts a stop to Suzu's evil!"
Paya: "Someday, I'm going to be famous... and Suzu will help me get there~ Heehee~ "
*I shiver.*
*Despite her soft, fluffy appearance... I think there's something colder, more sinister, to Paya than first meets the eye. She's actually... very strong-willed, isn't she?*
*I guess she has to be, given she's been Tsuzumi's friend for so long, but still...*
*M-Maybe this whole time, while I've been afraid of Tsuzumi... Paya was really the one I should have been looking out for.*
*Paya, with her sweet, unassuming smiles, her penchant for falling asleep, and her love of flowers.*
*I guess what they say is true.*
*You can never judge a book by its cover...*
Tsuzumi: "Again... It's just no good..."
*Tsuzumi sighs, head propped up with her right hand, as she sweeps her newly finished drawing off the counter.*
*Even though it was another good drawing... I guess it wasn't good enough for her.*
*We've been at this for hours now, and Tsuzumi still hasn't made any progress. If anything, her face looks even darker, more despondent, than before.*
*I hope she doesn't try to take her frustrations out on me. I don't want to be used as a stress ball, or a pin cushion...*
*I glance up at the clock hanging on the wall. It's almost 5:00 p.m. My train leaves at 7:00 p.m., and it takes about half an hour to reach the train station...*
*I should be leaving soon - and Noelle, Eri and Amu still haven't returned.*
*I shuffle about in my seat anxiously, crossing and uncrossing my legs, like a kid in the middle of an exam too shy to ask if they can go to the toilet.*
*What should I do...?*
*It's beginning to seem like our joint efforts will bear no fruit. Tsuzumi can't think of any ideas, and maybe Eri's rabbit still hasn't been found.*
*Does that mean... all this time I've spent with Tsuzumi has been a waste?*
*But... it isn't fair to think of it like that.*
*Even though I was roped into this against my will, and I didn't really want to help out... it was still fun. I had a nice time - especially when I went to the beach yesterday.*
*I should be more thankful.*
*My time here, back at my old home, was spent in a stranger, more unconventional way than I expected, but... it was still fun in its own way.*
*Maybe I'm a little glad that Tsuzumi asked me to help her. Just a little.*
*Even if my help hasn't really been all that... helpful.*
Tsuzumi: "Grr..."
*Tsuzumi leans over her work, her hands fisting in her dark hair, tugging at it so hard I worry she might pull clumps of it out.*
*I lean towards her, perhaps to tell her to stop, when...*
**ding**
*The bell over the door rings, signifying the arrival of a new customer.*
*Tsuzumi glowers, her face darkening.*
Tsuzumi: "Who the hell is this? Can't they read the sign on the door?"
*The sign on the door which doesn't, technically, say 'closed', but is so passive aggressive it would put most people off from entering.*
*Who is this intrepid explorer, brave enough to ignore the bright red sign hung up outside this shop?*
*I start to feel anxious, worrying on behalf of this mysterious new customer.*
*I hope, for their sake, they don't incur Tsuzumi's wrath. She's in a particularly rotten mood right now, and I worry one wrong word will send her into a murderous rage.*
*If Tsuzumi happened to kill our new customer, what would happen then? I really would be an accomplice to a crime then, wouldn't I?*
*I bet Tsuzumi wouldn't want to dispose of the body on her own. She'd get me to help - forcing me to hold the body down while she cut it up into manageable pieces; removing the arms, the legs, the head, and then dividing up the torso...*
*Sticky, red blood would leak out all over the floor and onto my hands, and I'd have to mop it all up.*
*Tsuzumi would bundle the pieces of body up into plastic bags, like one stores chicken breasts in the freezer, and I'd have to get rid of them.*
*She'd make me do all the dirty work. That definitely seems like something Tsuzumi would do.*
*Ah... N-No way... Just thinking about it is making me feel faint...*
*I don't want to become part of something like that! I never asked for this at all!*
*I beg you, mysterious customer... Please don't enter this store! It might be the last thing you ever do!*
Eri: "Aaah... Big Sis, Big Sis!"
Tsuzumi: "H-Huh? Eri?"
Eri: "Yes, it's me. Who else were you expecting?"
Tsuzumi: "I... I'm not sure... Ahaha..."
*Eri frowns.*
Eri: "And why are you holding that table lamp? You weren't going to hit me with it, were you?"
Tsuzumi: "Ah, um... O-Of course not! I mean, that was before I knew the person coming into my store would be you!"
*So she was planning to hit somebody with that thing?*
*Maybe my nightmarish 'what if' scenario wasn't so ridiculous after all...*
*Luckily, the person - people, rather - standing in the entrance of the store aren't strangers.*
*Standing in the middle is none other than Onodera Eri, with her golden hair tied up into those corkscrew curls, and attired in a pink dress that reminds me of strawberry ice cream.*
*Behind her are Amu and Noelle. They both look tired and are leaning against the doorframe for support.*
*Amu's hair is even more disheveled than usual, filled with sticks and leaves, and her socks have holes in them.*
*Noelle's bare arms and legs look scratched - no doubt from navigating through the forest, being dragged along behind an enthusiastic Eri.*
*Eri, in comparison, looks as sparklingly clean as a newly minted coin.*
Tsuzumi: "Ah, Eri... Eri! I'm so glad to see you! I missed you so much! I was scared I was never going to see you again!!!"
Tsuzumi: "Waaaaaaaah!"
*And with that, the older sister descends upon the younger like a hungry wolf, pulling her to her bosom.*
*Eri shifts, trying to push Tsuzumi away, with little success.*
Eri: "I-It's only been a few hours, stupid sister. Get off me!"
*Her voice sounds strangled. Is she having trouble breathing? What if Tsuzumi is suffocating her?*
*My vision of dismembered corpses may still come true yet...*
Tsuzumi: "It might have been a few hours to you - but to me, it felt like an eternity!"
Eri: "Is that meant to be impress me? Because it isn't working. At all."
Tsuzumi: "Waaah~ I even missed your cruel tongue!"
Eri: "T-That's so creepy! Get off me, you idiot - you'll hurt her!"
Tsuzumi: "W-Waah? I-Idiot? E-Eri, that's too cruel!"
*With a wail, Tsuzumi staggers backwards, her eyes wide.*
*I guess that's the most effective way to stop a rampaging Tsuzumi. Get her little sister to scold her.*
*Tsuzumi really is weak against little sisters, isn't she...?*
Eri: "Now, now... I'm sorry you had to witness that. I'm sure it was scary."
Eri: "I'm here now. I'll take care of you. You don't have to be afraid anymore."
*Eri starts to whisper under her breath, cooing baby talk in a mothering manner that seems very unlike her.*
*Ah... She's holding something in her arms, against her chest. A small, fluffy thing.*
*Could that be...?*
*I peer at Eri, eyes wide.*
*She's holding a soft, white creature with long, floppy ears.*
*It is, unmistakably... a rabbit.*
*Shiro...?*
Tsuzumi: "Aah! I'm so glad you were able to find him, Eriri!"
Eri: "Me, too! I'm so happy... I've never been happier!"
*Eri smiles widely, without a hint of embarrassment.*
*In the short while that I've been reacquainted with her, I don't know if I've ever seen Eri smile like that.*
*Because she isn't worrying what other people may think of her, or trying to keep up a ladylike façade... the real Onodera Eri is allowed to shine though, like the sunlight through a gap in the clouds.*
*The smile on her face... is dazzling.*
Eri: "Although, um... There is something I should say..."
Tsuzumi: "Oh? What's that?"
*Tsuzumi beams, holding out both her arms.*
Tsuzumi: "If you want a celebratory hug from your big sis, I'm right here! All you need to do is ask! Use me in whatever way you want, Eriri!"
Eri: "Ew. No, not that."
Tsuzumi: "Huh? So you don't want a hug?"
Eri: "No. I'd rather cut off my own left leg with a spoon."
Tsuzumi: "How mean... Your words wound me, Eri!"
Eri: "And your stupidity astounds me. Are you really that moronic, or do you just pretend to be?"
Tsuzumi: "Hmm..."
*Tsuzumi frowns, pressing one hand underneath her chin.*
Tsuzumi: "You know... It's very hard to tell. Perhaps it's a mixture of both?"
Eri: "Good grief..."
*If Eri weren't holding Shiro in her arms, I have no doubt she'd press her face into her palm.*
Tsuzumi: "Hehe~ I'm just weak to little sisters, you see~ And love make us all do crazy things~"
Tsuzumi: "If you told me to jump off a cliff, Eri, I'd do it without hesitation!"
Eri: "No. Please don't jump off a cliff. Even though you are annoying, I don't think you deserve to die."
*Tsuzumi smiles blissfully, apparently overwhelmed with emotion.*
Tsuzumi: "Yay~ Eri praised me~ "
Eri: "I don't know if telling somebody they don't deserve to die is the same as praising them, but whatever. You're free to delude yourself if you want."
Tsuzumi: "And I will keep on doing so, because deluding myself makes me happy~"
*At least she's open about it...?*
Tsuzumi: "So~ What is it you wanted to tell me, Eri?"
Eri: "Well, um..."
*Eri looks at the floor. I don't know if it's just my imagination, or... has her face turned a light shade of pink?*
Eri: "You know you called Shiro a 'him' a few moments ago...?"
Tsuzumi: "That's right. I did. I called him a 'him' because Shiro is a him, right? The only 'him' I will allow to touch you, Eri!"
*Wah... W-Why is Tsuzumi glaring at me?*
*The gleam in her eyes... it seems to suggest that, if I ever lay so much as a single finger on her beloved little sister, she'll cut it off. And then she'll chop up the rest of me for good measure.*
*Wawa...*
Eri: "Well, uh..."
Eri: "T-That's what I thought, too, but... according to Noelle, um..."

*So Shiro was actually a girl? And Eri didn't know...?*
*Isn't that, like, the most basic thing to know about your pet, other than what species it is?*
*Eri might be more scatterbrained than I thought...*
Amu: "Hmph."
*Amu watches Eri and Tsuzumi from afar, scowling, one hand on her hip.*
Amu: "Well, I'm glad somebody's happy..."
*I turn to Amu, blinking.*
Atcchan: "And you're not?"
Amu: "Well... I am, I suppose. I'm glad she was able to find her rabbit. But..."
Amu: "She was walking so fast, it was almost impossible to keep up with her. I nearly sprained my ankle."
Atcchan: "You mean not even you could follow her? You, Jougasaki Amu, who was so good at P.E. Miss Tachibana made you sit out because it wasn't fair to the other kids?"
Amu: "The very same..."
*Amu sighs, tilting her head to one side. Her neck cricks loudly, making me wince.*
Amu: "I never knew Eriri had so much stamina. I was left in the dust..."
Atcchan: "You've got some twigs in your hair, too."

*Amu sighs.*
Amu: "How come you always notice things like that, Atcchan?"

Amu: "Heh. You're more maternal than my own mom."
*Amu snorts, pulling a few stray bits of foliage out of her hair.*
Amu: "Did I get it?"
Atcchan: "Mm..."
*I stand on my tiptoes, trying to peer at the top of Amu's head. Why must I be so short...?*

*Watching her makes my fingers twitch, my mother hen instincts kicking in.*
*Just standing here watching her is painful. My desire to help is so overwhelming it's almost like a physical force.*

Atcchan: "Look, come here, you're not getting any of it. I'll do it for you."
Amu: "Ooh? That's unusually authoritative coming from you, Atcchan!"
Atcchan: "Well, maybe a little... I-I just don't like standing by, doing nothing. It sets me on edge."

Noelle: "This place would make quite a gloomy maid café..."

*What does that even mean? I'm not entirely sure, but it sounds kind of dubious...*

*I think that would be better for my heart.*

*Pouting, Amu eventually complies. She walks over to me and takes a seat at the counter, resting her arms against it.*
*I look down at the top of Amu's head, blinking. Suddenly being taller than her feels strange - as though I've been elevated into a rare position of power.*
*Maybe this is why Amu is always so fearless - because she's so tall? It's a liberating experience...*
*If I really was taller than Amu, maybe the power dynamic between the two of us would be different. Maybe I'd be a completely different person - cooler, more confident.*
*... Or maybe I'm just deluding myself.*
*Maybe height doesn't make all that much difference to personality after all. Most likely, being tall would just make me paranoid, perpetually worried that everybody was staring at me...*
*Perhaps I was made short for a reason. I'm just too delicate to handle the stress that comes with being a few inches taller. With great height comes great responsibility.*
Atcchan: "Okay... I'm going to start now."
*I reach forwards, ready to commence the slow, delicate process of extracting half the forest from Amu's hair.*
Atcchan: "..."
*There are more twigs and leaves in here than I thought. How did they get so deeply embedded inside her ponytail?*
*I move my hands carefully, trying hard not to pull any of her hair. Even though Amu can be a pain, I don't want to hurt her.*
Amu: "Ehehe... You're actually surprisingly good at this, Atcchan..."
Atcchan: "I am?"
Amu: "Yeah."

Amu: "It's kind of nice... Like I'm getting my head massaged. Ehehe~"
Noelle: "Ooh... That sounds interesting..."

Atcchan: "Uh, well..."
*I look away from Amu's scalp for a few moments and give Noelle a cursory glance.*
*Even though she seems just as tired as Amu, her face unusually flushed, she's in a much more pristine condition - her hair completely devoid of any sneaky bits and pieces of forestry.*
Atcchan: "You don't really need my help. Your hair looks just fine."

Noelle: "Incredibly. She wouldn't slow down for anything or anyone."

Amu: "Yeah. I guess I never really knew how much she loved Shiro until today. She was doing her best... Her very best."

*Then, I draw back, admiring my handiwork.*
*Amu's hair looks a lot neater than before; lying at less awkward, impossible angles. I feel proud. I doubt even Hercules could have completed this mammoth undertaking - and in only five minutes, too.*
Atcchan: "Right. I've finished."
Amu: "Ooh~ I feel much lighter already! "

Amu: "Like I've lost fifty pounds!"

Noelle: "But it isn't fair if you only do it for Amu, and not for me. I'll get jealous..."
Atcchan: "J-Jealous? Really?"
